name: Sales Agents
description: Pipeline, lead, and quote vocabulary + starter questions (IBM ai-agents-in-sales: lead scoring, CRM-integrated engagement, forecasting, coaching).
starter_prompts: Score this week's new leads against our ideal-customer profile
What is our win rate by product line this quarter vs last?
Which open opportunities are stalled and need a follow-up?

terminology.description: An unqualified potential customer. A lead becomes an 'opportunity' after qualification.
A qualified deal in the pipeline with expected value and close date.
Won opportunities divided by closed opportunities (won+lost) in a period.
Open pipeline value divided by quota — 3x is a common health floor.
Average days from opportunity creation to close.
Automated sequence of touches for not-yet-ready leads — outbound sends stay human-approved.
